newsitem.title: USA: Outdoor Systems sells $500 mln 144A notes.
newsitem.headline: Outdoor Systems sells $500 mln 144A notes.

text.p: The following debt issue from Outdoor Systems Inc was priced in the 144A private placement market on Tuesday via lead manager CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp, according to a syndicate official.
Outdoor Systems, based in Phoenix, Arizona is the largest out-of-home media company in the United States and Canada, operating poster, bulletin, transit shelter and subway displays.
